response.sql: SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS AverageListPrice, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS AverageBytesPerMillisecond FROM Track AS t INNER JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name;

assumptions.assumption: A track with zero length has no defined bytes-per-millisecond value, so it is excluded from that average.
